row.evidence: ProductPlan sells "One plan, everything and everyone included" with "no features locked behind an upgrade", and its help centre documents SCIM provisioning that admins set up from Account Settings > Security.
row.notes: New row. Single plan, sold by quote: pricing is tailored per use case and billed annually, per editor seat, with unlimited free viewers. SSO is 'available to all' and SCIM is documented with no plan restriction, so there is no SCIM upcharge (rule 1a, single plan). Because the only plan has no public price, rule 6a (quote-only = gated) could also be argued at merge. SCIM: bearer token generated in Security settings; users (userName, displayName, given/family name, active) and groups (displayName, members) mapped to Teams; editor licence via a 'ProductPlan Editors' group or per-team checkbox. Deprovisioning sets the user to Removed (kept, data retained, cannot log in). The help centre mentions Okta and Entra ID; the Okta OIN app is SWA only and the Entra gallery app is SSO/JIT only, so both use the generic endpoint. The REST API v2 (personal token) only lists users and teams.

plans.name: Product Intelligence Platform Plan
plans.notes: Single plan; priced per editor seat with free viewers; no public price.

auth.token_source: Account Settings > Security > SCIM Provisioning subtab, Generate Token (shows SCIM Base URL and Auth Token)

deprovision.data_retained: User kept on the account as Removed (Inactive tab); data stays so admins can transfer roadmaps; team memberships and permissions removed; user cannot log in.

attributes.notes: Help article writes the name attributes as user.givenName and user.familyName.

roles.how: Editor licence via membership of a group named 'ProductPlan Editors' or the Editors checkbox on a team-to-IdP-group mapping; everyone else is a viewer. Falls back to viewer when no editor licences are left.

limitations.text: Editor licences are assigned only while unused editor licences remain; otherwise users come in as viewers.
Unmapped IdP group names create new ProductPlan Teams.

scim.notes: SCIM version and base URL pattern are not stated in the public article; the base URL is shown in the app. The article discusses Okta and Entra ID group behaviour.

auth.notes: Personal access token tied to one user, sent as Bearer.

capabilities.notes: API reference lists only read endpoints for users and teams ('List your teams and users'); false is by absence from the reference.

endpoints.purpose: List all users in the account (page, page_size up to 500, q filter)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks reference lists only bar events (creates/updates/deletes a bar).

okta.notes: OIN app (last updated Mar. 13 2014) ticks SWA only (page markup). ProductPlan's own guide uses a custom SAML app; SCIM article discusses Okta groups, so generic SCIM is used.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial covers SAML SSO with JIT; no provisioning tutorial (productplan-provisioning-tutorial 404).
